quotes.en: A little light dispels a great deal of darkness.
quotes.ref: The Rebbe, repeated in his talks and published letters (Igros Kodesh; see L'Chaim Weekly translations)

quotes.en: The deed is the essential thing.
quotes.ref: The Rebbe's constant directive, rooted in Likkutei Dibburim of the Rebbe Rayatz (cf. Avos 1:17)
A hallmark of the Rebbe's farbrengens, rooted in the Talmud's teaching on joy (Shabbos 30b)

quotes.en: Every Jew is an entire world.
quotes.ref: The Rebbe's frequent call to count and value every Jew, based on Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:5

quotes.en: Think good, and it will be good.
quotes.ref: The Tzemach Tzedek's assurance (Kuntres HaShemidah), constantly quoted by the Rebbe

quotes.he: כָּל אֶחָד צָרִיךְ לִהְיוֹת מַדְלִיק נֵרוֹת - לְהָאִיר אֶת הַנְּשָׁמָה שֶׁבְּכָל אָדָם.
quotes.en: Each of us must be a lamplighter, kindling the soul in every person.
quotes.ref: A signature image of the Rebbe's sichos: the Jew as a lamplighter

quotes.en: If you know Aleph, teach Aleph.
quotes.ref: The Rebbe Rayatz's call, made the banner of outreach by the Rebbe

quotes.he: מִצְוָה אַחַת מַטָּה אֶת הָאָדָם וְאֶת כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ לְכַף זְכוּת.
quotes.en: A single mitzvah can tip a person, and the entire world, to the side of merit.
quotes.ref: Rambam, Mishneh Torah, Hilchos Teshuvah 3:4 - a teaching the Rebbe repeated constantly

quotes.en: You shall spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south.
quotes.ref: Bereishis 28:14 - the verse the Rebbe made the call of Jewish outreach

quotes.he: כְּשֶׁסּוֹפְרִים יְהוּדִים, אֵין גָּדוֹל וְאֵין קָטָן - כָּל אֶחָד נֶחְשָׁב.
quotes.en: When Jews are counted, no one is greater and no one is lesser - every single one counts.
quotes.ref: The Rebbe's sichos on counting the Jewish people (Parshas Ki Sisa)

quotes.he: כָּל הַמַּתְחִיל בְּמִצְוָה - אוֹמְרִים לוֹ: גְּמוֹר!
quotes.en: One who begins a mitzvah is told: finish it!
quotes.ref: Midrash Rabbah (Bereishis 85:3; Vayikra 11:7), often quoted by the Rebbe

quotes.he: כָּל נְשָׁמָה הִיא חֵלֶק אֱלוֹקַ מִמַּעַל מָמָשׁ.
quotes.en: Every soul is literally a part of G-d above.
quotes.ref: Tanya, ch. 2 (quoting Iyov 31:2) - the foundation of the Rebbe's love for every Jew

quotes.he: כָּל מַעֲשֶׂה טוֹב מוֹסִיף לְבֵנָה בַּדִּירָה שֶׁאָנוּ בּוֹנִים לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
quotes.en: Every good deed adds a brick to the dwelling we build for G-d.
quotes.ref: Based on the Rebbe's first maamar, Basi L'Gani 5711 (1951): making this world a dwelling for G-d

images.note: The celebration overlay shows a photo of the Lubavitcher Rebbe from /rebbe/<n>.jpg. The component picks a random number n between 1 and REBBE_IMAGE_COUNT (default 10). Fill public/rebbe/ with real photos named 1.jpg, 2.jpg, ... and set REBBE_IMAGE_COUNT to how many you added. If an image is missing the photo hides itself and the quote still shows. Use photos you have the right to use.
